Message:
ci(security): add devsecops pipeline, DefectDojo upload and STRIDE model

New devsecops workflow: images built once, then Semgrep (SAST),
Gitleaks and TruffleHog (secrets, full history), Trivy (SCA + SBOM,
images, Dockerfiles), Semgrep compose rules and ZAP baseline + an
authenticated ZAP API scan against the running stack. Gates block on
main and report on develop (constitution EX-001); reports are kept 7
days and re-imported into DefectDojo through the tunnel when its
secrets exist. Scripts under security/ are tested in CI.

Adds the filled course STRIDE template and the MisiOps data-flow
diagram. No remediation yet: the first run is the baseline.

Author: yriveros
Message:
fix(frontend): purge the legacy local-ledger key on boot

A browser that had used the pre-backend, browser-local version of the
app (PRs #5-#10) still had real data sitting under misiops.ledger.v1
after this feature shipped: nothing writes or reads it anymore, but
nothing removed it either, so it stayed readable via devtools
indefinitely. Violates FR-012 and SC-006.

Missed in this PR's own verification because the browser used for that
testing had never loaded the pre-integration app, so it never had the
key to find. Caught by the user testing from a browser with real
history, running the quickstart's own step 7.

AppShell now sweeps the legacy key once on boot, independent of session
state, so any browser with the old key is cleaned the next time it
loads the app.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Message:
feat(frontend): add category management

Implements specs/003-category-management: users get seeded default
categories for both types, and can create, rename and delete their own.
Deleting a category reassigns its transactions to the per-type "Sin
categoría" fallback instead of dropping them, and that fallback is
locked against rename/delete so entry is never blocked.

Category type is fixed at creation rather than editable, which satisfies
FR-006 (no type change once transactions exist) without extra guards.

Also lands the shared frontend foundation this and later features build
on: design tokens, app shell, and the ledger store. Persistence is
browser-local for now; swapping it for the FastAPI backend is contained
to storage.ts.

The root .gitignore's Python "lib/" rule was silently excluding
frontend/app/lib, so it is negated for that path.
